description: Explicit platform integration gates. These cases may require a real desktop session, device, service, credentials, or may temporarily affect host state.

packages.name: clipboard
packages.notes: The example snapshots and restores the system clipboard. Run only in an interactive desktop session.

packages.name: com
packages.notes: Uses an in-process IDispatch test object and verifies COM VARIANT to current XRT xvalue conversion.

packages.name: uia
packages.notes: Creates an in-process native test window and verifies UI Automation element collections use current XRT xvalue arrays.

packages.name: ui.auto
packages.notes: Exercises the high-level locator, wait, input, read, and click flow against the UIA package test window.

packages.name: daemon
packages.notes: Creates a named daemon service object, reads pid/running/daemonized status, checks process liveness, and stops the service before exit.

packages.name: sysinfo
packages.notes: Reads OS, architecture, CPU, memory, page size, and uptime facts from the local host. Read-only queries with no host state change.

packages.name: watch
packages.notes: Registers filesystem watch handles on package-local files, polls one event batch, and removes the watches before exit.

packages.name: singleinstance
packages.notes: Acquires a named single-instance lock, verifies acquisition state, and releases the lock before exit.

packages.name: sharedmem
packages.notes: Creates a named Windows shared-memory block, writes and reads back string and integer payloads, and destroys the block before exit.

packages.name: serial
packages.notes: Loopback byte/text I/O, capacity/short-write, lifetime and error tests; C also covers concurrent streams. Allocation failure is verified separately by check_extlib_serial.ps1. No physical serial device is required; real device validation is separate.
